fact: The World Bank's status report archived on 20 June 2025 lists disbursement-linked indicator 3 of the Morocco Health Reform Program, improved content, quality, accessibility and use of health data, with US$37.5 million of the US$450 million IBRD loan allocated and nothing disbursed, rates it off-track, gives as its baseline an integrated and digitalised health information system deployed at hospitals with deployment begun in primary health care centres, and attributes the Program's downgrade to moderately satisfactory partly to gradual progress on digitalisation of the health system.
title: Implementation Status & Results Report: Morocco Health Reform Program (P179014), Seq No: 4
